response.overview: A strange feeling. A fleeting glance. Something just out of sight. Kuerz & Knackeg VOL. 3: Shivers brings together six short films made in Luxembourg, where the familiar starts to feel a little… off. Mysterious encounters, unexpected turns, uneasy moments — and a few things better left unseen. Six stories that invite you to look twice, and might just send a shiver down your spine. FADE TO BLACK by Anne Simon & Céline Camara, IVY by Solveig Harper, CRACKLE by Fränk Grotz, SCALP by Frederico Majerus, ARTICLE 19-42 by Julien Becker, and QUENOTTES by Gil Pinheiro & Pascal Thiebaux.
response.title: Kuerz & Knackeg VOL. 3: Shivers
